## Checks

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] Tests come with the change (or I explain below why none are needed)
- [ ] Changed a map generator? I ran `npm run gen` and committed what it wrote
- [ ] Changed the protocol, a map or items? I bumped the version, and it does not collide with `main`
- [ ] Added a migration? It only adds things and has the next free number
- [ ] Keeps, logs or shares something new about players? The [privacy policy](https://github.com/napoland-com/napoland/blob/main/apps/client/public/privacy.html) says so
